prompts.question: Reason In a work-rate problem, explain why you can't average the individual rates to determine how long it will take to complete a job together.
prompts.answer: Averaging the two rates would result in a rate less than the faster person's rate. But two individuals working together would complete the work in less time than the person with the faster rate could do alone.
